messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Hi, I'm an AI interview assistant. This call is being transcribed for the hiring team, and a person, not the AI, makes the final decision. I'll ask you a few questions about the projects on your resume.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: For the NABHA Telemedicine Platform, how did you design the backend REST APIs to handle patient data securely?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: No problem, let's move on. How did you handle on-call rotations and reliability for CivicFix?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: I'm sorry. Can you repeat the question?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: How did you handle on-call rotations and reliability for CivicFix?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: No problem, let's move on. How did you store and manage the large volume of race telemetry data when building your Formula One Race Strategy Optimizer?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: Okay. So Civic Fix was primarily a project rather than a large production system. With a formal twenty four by seven on call rotation we handled reliability at the team level. We assigned responsibility for monitoring issues and responding to bugs. Whenever something broke, we first reproduced it, checked the logs, identified the root cause, and then deployed a fix. Also use gate for version control so changes could be tracked and reverted if necessary. If I were taking the system to production, I would add proper monitoring alerts, health checks.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You said "Civic Fix". What exactly did you do there, step by step?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: And a formal on call rotation.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thank you. Moving on. How did your team handle CI/CD pipelines and automated testing while building the NABHA Telemedicine Platform?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: We used Git and collaborative branch based workflow, so team members could work on different parts of the application. Without directly affecting the main branch. We test for individual end components and APIs before integrating them with the front end. For CICD, the idea was to automate the build and testing process whenever changes were pushed. So that integration issues could be caught early. We also kept configurations such as API keys and credentials outside of source code. The biggest benefit of that was that every change went through consistent development and validation process instead of relying only on manual testing.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You said 'we' - what part of that was specifically your own work, versus the team's?

messages.speaker: candidate
messages.text: I basically worked on the CICD pipelines where I brought the idea to automate the build and testing process whenever the changes were pushed.

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: You said "CICD pipelines". Do you have a number for that - how much, how many, or how fast?

messages.speaker: agent
messages.text: Thanks, that's all my questions. The transcript of this call now goes to the hiring team, and a person there will review it and decide the next step.
